messages:
Ivy: Quick heads-up - publisher portal shows account 999888 but no SKUs. We did the onboarding run 5m ago.
Rohan: likely IAM propagation. onboarding job may have raced the policy attach.
Tess: can someone run assume-role + list-entitlements to confirm? if 403 it's perms.
Ivy: running quick test now:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::999888:role/MarketplacePublisherRole --role-session-name debug
aws marketplace-entitlement list-entitlements --profile assumed --product-code redwood-pro
```
Ivy: result = AccessDenied on ListEntitlements.
Rohan: ok confirm. short-term fix: delay first entitlement poll by 30s after role attach and retry 4x. Longer-term we should surface a gating check in the publish pipeline so listing won't proceed until entitlements and EULA locales are present.
LegalBot: Reminder: EU locales must include EULA links (en, fr, de) in the manifest. Missing entries trigger compliance delist.
Tess: i'll open an ops ticket and add the gating check to the publish checklist in the console.
deploy-bot: Ticket created MP-6782: "IAM propagation causing empty SKU listing for acct 999888" assigned to cloudops. https://issues.redwood.com/MP-6782
Ivy: thanks. action items: Rohan add 30s delay + retry, Tess add publish gating, LegalBot confirm EULA URLs in manifest. We'll reconvene after ticket updates. :thumbsup:
